answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 233 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ripple. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the canyon queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier goes on earning. The kernel index is deterministic from ledger replay, and as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 22 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
